mascot: Measuring Mihir — a curious Class 1 boy with a ribbon ruler, a tiny notebook and chalk-dusty hands

slides.title: Long and Short 📏
slides.text: Things can be LONG or SHORT! A pencil is longer than an eraser. A road is long; a matchstick is short. We compare length by looking carefully!
slides.spoken: Long things stretch more; short things take less space.

slides.title: Tall and Short 🌳
slides.text: When things stand UP we say TALL or short! A tree is taller than a flower. Giraffes are tall; dogs are short!
slides.spoken: The tree stands taller than the little flower.

slides.title: Compare the RIGHT Way 🤝
slides.text: To compare fairly, put things side by side at the SAME starting line! Line up the ends, then look: which one sticks out more is longer!
slides.spoken: Line up both ends at the same starting line, then compare.

steps: The one sticking out is longer!

slides.title: Measure with Handspans 🖐️
slides.text: We can measure with our BODY! Spread your fingers — that is a HANDSPAN. The table is 6 handspans; the stool is 3 handspans. More handspans means longer!
slides.spoken: Count handspans to measure — more handspans means longer.

slides.title: Order by Length 🥇
slides.text: We can put three things in ORDER: longest, middle, shortest! Ribbon, pencil, button: ribbon longest, pencil middle, button shortest!
slides.spoken: Line them up and order: longest, middle, shortest.

challenges.question: Which is LONGER?
challenges.hint: Picture both on your desk — which stretches more?
challenges.misconception: A pencil is longer than a little eraser.

challenges.question: Which is TALLER?
challenges.hint: Look up — which one reaches the sky?
challenges.misconception: A tree stands much taller than a flower.

challenges.question: What is the right way to compare two pencils?
challenges.hint: Fair comparing needs both pencils at the same start!
challenges.misconception: Lining them up at the same starting point shows which is longer.

challenges.question: The table is 6 handspans and the stool is 3 handspans. Which is longer?
challenges.misconception: 6 handspans is more than 3, so the table is longer.

challenges.question: Sort each thing: is it LONG or SHORT?
challenges.hint: Think about how much space each one takes!
challenges.misconception: Buses and rivers stretch a long way. Matchsticks and buttons are tiny.

challenges.question: Which animal is the SHORTEST?
challenges.hint: Which one can you barely see on the ground?
challenges.misconception: An ant is much shorter than a dog or a giraffe.

challenges.question: Ravi is taller than Meena. Meena is taller than Binu. Who is the TALLEST?
challenges.hint: Ravi beats Meena, and Meena beats Binu. So who is on top?
challenges.misconception: Ravi is taller than both, so Ravi is the tallest.

challenges.question: Your book is 2 handspans long. Your friend's book is 3 handspans. Whose book is longer?
challenges.hint: 3 handspans or 2 handspans — which is more?
challenges.misconception: 3 handspans is more than 2, so your friend's book is longer.
